items: PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana enrolled 9.99M first-time employees (2.85M women = 28.56%). Maharashtra led registrations.
**Enrolment Stats:** Of 9.99M first-time workers, **2.85 million were women (28.56%)** vs 7.14M men.
**Scheme Outlay:** Implemented Aug 1, 2025 to July 31, 2027 with **₹99,446 crore** outlay.
≠ **Outlay & Period:** 2-year implementation period with ₹99,446 crore outlay.
